research_capabilities.method: Use same immutable LiteSVM accounts/programs snapshot, market, direction, token mints and raw input amount. Compare exact output, reverse round-trip, spread, CU and failures.

research_capabilities.production_boundary: Research only. Never deploy spoof binaries under aggregator ids, alter mainnet instruction program ids, or claim authentic aggregator execution. For execution, use the genuine aggregator official API/build path.

archive_rules: Clone into temporary directory, checkout exact commit detached, then git archive into reviewed vendor path; do not leave nested .git.
Save original upstream LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING and provenance.json next to each snapshot.
Compute SHA-256 of archive and license files; verify commit with git rev-parse HEAD.
Run cargo metadata --locked; retain Cargo.lock. Resolve branch-based git dependencies to immutable revisions. Do not allow floating main/master dependencies.
Run cargo-deny/cargo-audit or repository-approved equivalents before building; record transitive licenses and advisories.
Do not add vendored tools to pyproject runtime dependencies or supported composition root until an adapter PR passes tests and packaging gates.
If source lacks a complete license, stop mirroring and keep URL+metadata only.
An external source archive is not a runtime capability, source credential, API subscription or permission to contact provider infrastructure.
